newsitem.title: USA: Choice Hotels names real estate officers.
newsitem.headline: Choice Hotels names real estate officers.

text.p: Choice Hotels International Inc said Thursday Antonio Dirico was appointed president and chief operating officer of its real estate spinoff and Donald Landry will be chief executive of the new company.
Sunburst Hospitality Corp was approved by Choice's board as the company's new name after the spinoff. At that time, the franchising company will adopt Choice Hotels International Inc as its name.
Choice had previously announced a plan to divide its business through a pro-rata spinoff to shareholders of its franchising operations.
Sunburst Hospitality will own and manage 71 hotels in the United States, with 20 hotels currently under construction or in the development process.

Choice Hotels International is the second-largest hotel franchisor in the world with 4,089 hotels open or under development representing 350,065 rooms in 33 countries, marketed under the brand names Comfort, Quality, Econo Lodge, Sleep, Clarion, Rodeway and MainStay Suites.
